description: The Applicant is seeking full planning permission for the repurposing and retrofitting of the existing building at 8 Canada Square to facilitate continued office use, in addition to new hotel and food & beverage and leisure uses. The structure and massing of parts of the existing building is proposed to be cut back, to form terraces at the base, middle and upper levels. The building fa‡ade is proposed to be reclad with different materials than existing. The existing plant levels are proposed to be reconfigured to include leisure space. It is anticipated that the ground levels (lower ground and upper ground) will provide retail, the ground floor mezzanine and level 1 will provide lobby and leisure arrival and levels 2 - 32 will remain as workspace. A hotel is proposed at levels 33 - 41; however, the Applicant is seeking flexibility within the permission such that these floors may alternatively be delivered as office workspace. A space comprising a leisure destination and food and beverage uses at levels 42 and 43 is proposed. It is anticipated that the entire basement, all piles, and most of the structural frame will be retained (no below ground structural works). This description of works proposed, and resultant development, is hereafter referred to as the 'Proposed Development'.
